title: Pan-Seared Duck Legs with Confit Crust
description: A delicious and flavorful dish featuring duck legs with a crispy confit crust, perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: 4 duck legs
ingredients.notes: Make sure to pat dry with paper towels before cooking

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup duck confit
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought confit works well

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp herbal thyme
ingredients.notes: Fresh or dried thyme works well

instructions: Season the duck legs with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck legs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through.
While the duck is cooking, mix together the confit, thyme, and garlic powder in a small bowl.
Remove the duck from the oven and brush the confit mixture evenly over the top of each leg.
Return the skillet to the oven and cook for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the confit is crispy and golden brown.
Serve the duck legs hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
